title: POV: You Stop Buying Extras for 30 Days… and Find $420 YOU Didn't Know You Had 💸

lines: Today is November first. And for thirty days... you're not buying anything extra.
scenes.img: {HERO} writing No-Spend in a small notebook at a sunny kitchen table with a coffee mug, determined smile, vertical composition

lines: Americans said they spend about three hundred fourteen dollars a month on impulse buys.
scenes.img: a cheerful young woman with a ponytail in a cozy hallway next to a tall stack of cardboard parcels, raised eyebrows, vertical composition

lines: So first, you write your rules. Rent, bills, groceries? Allowed. Takeout and online shopping? Paused.
scenes.img: {HERO} writing a two-column list in his notebook at a desk, focused face, vertical composition

lines: You delete your saved cards. And unsubscribe from every store email.
scenes.img: {HERO} on the sofa deleting emails on his phone, relieved smile, vertical composition

lines: Something you want? You don't buy it. You write it on a wish list... and wait.
scenes.img: {HERO} in a store aisle writing in his notebook next to a nice jacket on a hanger, calm smile, vertical composition

lines: Every day you don't spend, you move ten or fifteen dollars straight into savings.
scenes.img: {HERO} putting money into a big glass savings jar with a star, proud smile, vertical composition

lines: Black Friday? You buy only what was on your list before the sale. Nothing else.
scenes.img: {HERO} calmly walking past a crowded store with huge sale signs, holding one shoebox, vertical composition

lines: December first, you have four hundred twenty dollars more. The full seven-step plan is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} holding a jar full of money and giving a thumbs up to the viewer in a bright kitchen, vertical composition
